title.ja: Phoning「HYEIN DAY」ヘインの初ライブ

summary.ja: 公式アプリPhoningのメンバー別「DAY」企画でヘインが初ライブ配信。
summary.en: Hyein's first live broadcast on the official app Phoning, during the member-by-member 'DAY' launch week.

detail.ja: 2022年7月27日、7月25日に公開された公式コミュニケーションアプリ「Phoning」のメンバー別「DAY」企画の一環として、ヘインが初めてライブ配信を行った。公式Xは当日「Today is HYEIN DAY! Phoningでヘインとベフになろう」と告知した。ライブはアプリ内で配信され、後日リプレイが提供される。
detail.en: On July 27, 2022, as part of the member-by-member 'DAY' launch week of the official communication app Phoning (released July 25), Hyein held her first live broadcast. The official X account announced 'Today is HYEIN DAY!' that morning. Lives stream inside the app with replays made available later.

editor_note: Date and content from the fan-maintained namu.wiki "NewJeans/Phoning LIVE" log; Phoning replays are app-only and could not be fetched. Not confirmed from an official source. Member-DAY X posts are listed in namu.wiki "NewJeans/활동".

title.ja: Phoning デビュー100日記念フェイスコール

summary.ja: デビュー100日を記念し、Phoningで約55分のフェイスコールを実施。
summary.en: A roughly 55-minute face call on Phoning marking 100 days since debut.

detail.ja: 2022年10月29日、デビュー100日を記念してPhoningで全員参加の約55分のフェイスコールが行われた。同日、公式SNSとYouTubeでファンダム名「Bunnies」とペンライト「Binky Bong」が公開され、メンバーはPhoningで韓国語と英語の100日メッセージも投稿した。
detail.en: On October 29, 2022, the 100th day since debut, a roughly 55-minute face call with all members was held on Phoning. The same day the fandom name Bunnies and the Binky Bong light stick were revealed on official SNS and YouTube, and the members posted 100-day messages in Korean and English on Phoning.

editor_note: Date and content from the fan-maintained namu.wiki "NewJeans/Phoning LIVE" log; Phoning replays are app-only and could not be fetched. Not confirmed from an official source. Phoning anniversary messages confirmed by iMBC (2022-10-30).

title.ja: [NewJeans Day] デビュー3周年おめでとう

summary.ja: デビュー記念日の記念映像。

detail.ja: 2025年7月22日、NewJeans公式YouTubeチャンネルで「Happy 3rd Anniversary」が公開された。デビュー記念日「NewJeans Day」（7月22日）に合わせて公式YouTubeチャンネルで公開された記念映像。デビュー3周年当日に公開された約20秒の記念映像。同日、ADORは公式SNSで「NewJeans Day On-Air」として未公開写真も公開した。
detail.en: On July 22, 2025, the official NewJeans YouTube channel released 'Happy 3rd Anniversary', an anniversary video posted on the official YouTube channel for 'NewJeans Day', the group's debut anniversary (July 22). A roughly 20-second anniversary clip released on the third debut anniversary; the same day ADOR also posted unreleased photos on official SNS as 'NewJeans Day On-Air'.

editor_note: YouTube page (reader, US-Pacific display) shows Jul 21/22, 2025; Korean media (TenAsia 2025-07-22) report both NewJeans Day videos as released on July 22 KST.

title.ja: 「NewJeans Day On Air」3周年記念配信

summary.ja: デビュー3周年にADORが公式SNS/YouTubeで「NewJeans Day On-Air」を展開。
summary.en: ADOR's 'NewJeans Day On-Air' third-anniversary programme on official SNS and YouTube.

detail.ja: 2025年7月22日、デビュー3周年に合わせてADORは公式SNSで「NewJeans Day On-Air」と題して未公開写真を公開し、公式YouTubeチャンネルでは「[NewJeans Day] Happy 3rd Anniversary」と「[NewJeans Day] We are NewJeans」を公開した。
detail.en: On July 22, 2025, the third debut anniversary, ADOR ran 'NewJeans Day On-Air': unreleased photos on official SNS, and the videos '[NewJeans Day] Happy 3rd Anniversary' and '[NewJeans Day] We are NewJeans' on the official YouTube channel.

editor_note: TenAsia reported a ~19-hour YouTube stream (850-900 concurrent viewers at 16:00); no stream VOD ID found on the channel, and other outlets describe "On-Air" as an SNS post. Treat the stream claim with caution. / TenAsia reported a roughly 19-hour stream on the official YouTube channel (00:00-19:00 KST; 850-900 concurrent viewers at 16:00); no stream VOD ID was found on the channel and other outlets describe 'On-Air' as an SNS post, so the stream claim is unverified and kept out of reader text.

title.ja: Weverseで「Bunnies Club」利用開始を告知
title.en: ADOR announces 'Bunnies Club' access on Weverse

summary.ja: ADORが公式Xで、Bunnies ClubをWeverse上で利用できると告知。
summary.en: ADOR announces via the official X account that Bunnies Club can now be accessed on Weverse.

detail.ja: 2026年7月23日、ADORはNewJeans公式Xを通じて、公式ファンクラブ兼メンバーシップ「Bunnies Club」をグローバルファンプラットフォームWeverseで利用できるようになったと告知した。前日22日にはデビュー4周年映像「2026 Summer of NewJeans」が公開され、23日には「4 Years of NewJeans」をテーマにした写真とTikTokショート動画も投稿された。
detail.en: On July 23, 2026, ADOR announced through NewJeans' official X account that 'Bunnies Club', the official fan club and membership service, could now be accessed on the global fan platform Weverse. The '2026 Summer of NewJeans' fourth-anniversary videos had been released the day before, and '4 Years of NewJeans' photos and short TikTok videos were posted on the 23rd.

editor_note: Nocut News (English) 2026-07-23 article fetched. The X post URL was not retrieved.
